name: Beekman Golf Course
cardNote: Official 2025 scorecard images provide the Highland, Valley and Taconic pars, yards and facility-wide 1–27 handicaps. White and Gold rows reconcile to every printed nine and combination total; the Blue Valley row is omitted because its printed hole values total 3,224 while the combination summary implies 3,200. Ratings and slopes are not printed. Physical IDs 1–9 are Highland, 10–18 Valley and 19–27 Taconic; the app offers every ordered 18-hole pairing. Retrieved October 21, 2026.
